optimized_sql:
WITH ss AS (
    SELECT s.ss_customer_sk AS ss_customer_sk,
           s.ss_item_sk AS ss_item_sk,
           s.ss_ticket_number AS ss_ticket_number,
           s.ss_store_sk AS ss_store_sk,
           s.ss_net_profit AS ss_net_profit
    FROM store_sales s
    JOIN date_dim d1 ON d1.d_date_sk = s.ss_sold_date_sk
    WHERE d1.d_moy = 4 AND d1.d_year = 1999
),
sr AS (
    SELECT r.sr_customer_sk AS sr_customer_sk,
           r.sr_item_sk AS sr_item_sk,
           r.sr_ticket_number AS sr_ticket_number,
           r.sr_net_loss AS sr_net_loss
    FROM store_returns r
    JOIN date_dim d2 ON d2.d_date_sk = r.sr_returned_date_sk
    WHERE d2.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d2.d_year = 1999
),
cs_agg AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT c.cs_bill_customer_sk AS cs_bill_customer_sk,
           c.cs_item_sk AS cs_item_sk,
           MAX(c.cs_net_profit) AS cs_profit
    FROM catalog_sales c
    JOIN date_dim d3 ON d3.d_date_sk = c.cs_sold_date_sk
    WHERE d3.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d3.d_year = 1999
    GROUP BY c.cs_bill_customer_sk, c.cs_item_sk
)
SELECT i.i_item_id,
       i.i_item_desc,
       s.s_store_id,
       s.s_store_name,
       MAX(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit,
       MAX(sr.sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss,
       MAX(cs_agg.cs_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
FROM ss
JOIN sr ON ss.ss_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
      AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
      AND ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
JOIN cs_agg ON ss.ss_customer_sk = cs_agg.cs_bill_customer_sk
      AND ss.ss_item_sk = cs_agg.cs_item_sk
JOIN store s ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_item_desc, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name
ORDER BY i.i_item_id, i.i_item_desc, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name
LIMIT 100
